text:
Priya: Need help scheduling final loop for Arpita Nair (SWE IC3). She's in IST and prefers remote; available Mon-Wed next week 19:00-21:00 IST. Also requested large-print materials and that the coding exercise be unsupervised. Can someone own coordination?
Jordan L: I can do scheduling. Who should be on panel?
Sam Patel: Panel = Priya (hiring manager) + Jordan L + Maya K + bar raiser (Theo). Two 40m interviews + 30m debrief. Prefer 19:00 IST start.
Maya K: I'll set up Zoom + create large-font PDF and flag exercise as "no live proctor" in the packet. If she later wants onsite, facilities-bot can reserve an accessible room.
facilities-bot: Accessible room SF-1A (wider table, ramp) available Tue 09:00-12:00 PST. Badge request template prefilled.
Priya: We'll do remote for now. Please send NDA + interview packet with rubric. Also offer $30 remote internet stipend or $75 onsite travel stipend if she prefers to come in.
Jordan L: Proposed slots sent via Greenhouse: Mon 19:00 IST / Tue 19:00 IST / Wed 19:00 IST. Candidate picked Tue 19:00 IST. I'll send calendar invites with rubric reminders.
interview-bot: Calendar invites and Zoom link sent to panel and candidate. Tech-check scheduled 10 minutes before.
Maya K: Tech-check note: invite at 18:50 IST to verify screen share and font. I'll pin the large-font exercise and add verbal pacing guidance for interviewers.
travel-ops: If candidate changes to onsite, we can provide visa support letter and cover economy travel; submit TRVL-req-2026.
Priya: Sent DocuSign NDA and large-font PDF to Arpita. Also sent stipend form link: https://redwood-hr.s3/forms/stipend-claim.pdf
Jordan L: All set. I'll remind panel 24h before and include accessibility notes: speak clearly, allow extra time, avoid rapid-fire questions.
Sam Patel: Confirmed Theo is available Tue 19:00 IST. Marked my calendar.
Priya: Checklist: 1) Candidate confirmed Tue 19:00 IST (Jordan) 2) Zoom + tech-check (Maya) 3) NDA + packet sent (Priya) 4) stipend form shared (Priya) 5) accessible room on hold if needed (facilities-bot)
Maya K: Reception will hold a loaner laptop if she chooses onsite; need confirmation 48h prior to approve pickup.
Priya: Thanks team. Closing loop once candidate completes tech-check and signs NDA. :thumbsup:
Jordan L: Thanks everyone.
